defmodule PaymentGateway.OrderController do
  use PaymentGateway.Web, :controller
  alias PaymentGateway.{Repo, Order, PaymentService, CartService}

  @max_discount_percent 50
  @loyalty_tiers %{bronze: 5, silver: 10, gold: 15, platinum: 20}

  def checkout(conn, %{"order_id" => order_id} = params) do
    with {:ok, user} <- get_authenticated_user(conn),
         {:ok, order} <- fetch_order(order_id, user),
         {:ok, cart_items} <- CartService.get_items(order.cart_id),
         {:ok, pricing} <- calculate_final_price(cart_items, user, params) do
      case PaymentService.charge(user.payment_method, pricing.final_amount) do
        {:ok, transaction} ->
          finalize_order(order, transaction, pricing)
          json(conn, %{status: "success", transaction_id: transaction.id})
        {:error, reason} ->
          json(conn |> put_status(402), %{status: "payment_failed", reason: reason})
      end
    else
      {:error, reason} -> json(conn |> put_status(400), %{error: reason})
    end
  end

  defp calculate_final_price(cart_items, user, params) do
    subtotal = Enum.reduce(cart_items, Decimal.new("0"), fn item, acc ->
      item_total = Decimal.mult(item.price, Decimal.new(item.quantity))
      Decimal.add(acc, item_total)
    end)

    loyalty_discount = compute_loyalty_discount(user.loyalty_tier, subtotal)
    promo_discount = compute_promo_discount(params["promo_code"], subtotal)

    total_discount = aggregate_discounts(loyalty_discount, promo_discount, subtotal)
    final_amount = Decimal.sub(subtotal, total_discount)

    if Decimal.compare(final_amount, Decimal.new("0")) == :lt do
      {:error, "invalid_pricing_calculation"}
    else
      {:ok, %{
        subtotal: subtotal,
        loyalty_discount: loyalty_discount,
        promo_discount: promo_discount,
        total_discount: total_discount,
        final_amount: final_amount
      }}
    end
  end

  defp compute_loyalty_discount(tier, subtotal) when is_atom(tier) do
    percent = Map.get(@loyalty_tiers, tier, 0)
    Decimal.mult(subtotal, Decimal.div(Decimal.new(percent), Decimal.new(100)))
  end

  defp compute_promo_discount(nil, _subtotal), do: Decimal.new("0")
  defp compute_promo_discount(promo_code, subtotal) do
    case Repo.get_by(PromoCode, code: promo_code, active: true) do
      nil -> Decimal.new("0")
      promo ->
        case promo.discount_type do
          :percentage ->
            Decimal.mult(subtotal, Decimal.div(Decimal.new(promo.value), Decimal.new(100)))
          :fixed ->
            Decimal.min(Decimal.new(promo.value), subtotal)
        end
    end
  end

  defp aggregate_discounts(loyalty_discount, promo_discount, subtotal) do
    combined = Decimal.add(loyalty_discount, promo_discount)
    max_allowed = Decimal.mult(subtotal, Decimal.div(Decimal.new(@max_discount_percent), Decimal.new(100)))

    # Cap total discount at maximum allowed percentage
    if Decimal.compare(combined, max_allowed) == :gt do
      max_allowed
    else
      combined
    end
  end

  defp finalize_order(order, transaction, pricing) do
    order
    |> Order.changeset(%{
      status: :paid,
      transaction_id: transaction.id,
      amount_charged: pricing.final_amount,
      discount_applied: pricing.total_discount
    })
    |> Repo.update!()
  end

  defp fetch_order(order_id, user) do
    case Repo.get_by(Order, id: order_id, user_id: user.id) do
      nil -> {:error, "order_not_found"}
      order -> {:ok, order}
    end
  end

  defp get_authenticated_user(conn) do
    case conn.assigns[:current_user] do
      nil -> {:error, "unauthorized"}
      user -> {:ok, user}
    end
  end
end

defmodule PaymentGateway.CartService do
  alias PaymentGateway.{Repo, CartItem}

  def get_items(cart_id) do
    items = Repo.all(from c in CartItem, where: c.cart_id == ^cart_id)
    case items do
      [] -> {:error, "empty_cart"}
      items -> {:ok, items}
    end
  end

  def update_quantity(cart_id, item_id, quantity) when quantity > 0 do
    case Repo.get_by(CartItem, cart_id: cart_id, id: item_id) do
      nil -> {:error, "item_not_found"}
      item ->
        item
        |> CartItem.changeset(%{quantity: quantity})
        |> Repo.update()
    end
  end
end

defmodule PaymentGateway.PaymentService do
  @callback charge(payment_method :: map(), amount :: Decimal.t()) ::
    {:ok, map()} | {:error, String.t()}

  def charge(payment_method, amount) do
    if Decimal.compare(amount, Decimal.new("0")) == :gt do
      # Process payment with external gateway
      ExternalGateway.process(payment_method, amount)
    else
      {:error, "invalid_amount"}
    end
  end
end
